item.title: 1.0.0-beta1
item.description:
anotherMessenger v1.0.0-beta1

  • Built-in in-place DMG auto-downloader and installer with Beta / Stable channel selector.
  • Isolated Messenger message row flex layout with CSS contain to fix wheel scroll freezes.
  • Native macOS notifications with click-to-navigate, lock-screen privacy, and Now Playing isolation.
  • Smooth Vietnamese IME input with native Safari User-Agent and WKScriptMessageHandler bridge.
  • License deactivation with automatic backup and restore of paid settings (Polar.sh).
